pattern.description: The recorded cursor glides from one idea card to the one below; the hover tint and expand icon hand off from the first card to the second.
pattern.why_premium: Hover states follow the pointer exactly, so the viewer's eye is led card to card while the narrator says the ideas are organized by the field.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.cursor', {y: '+=170', x: '-=40', duration: 0.17, ease: 'power1.inOut'}); tl.set('.card.slack', {className: 'card'}, '<0.05'); tl.set('.card.perf', {className: 'card is-hover'}, '>-0.05') (hover tint and expand icon toggled, no tween).
build_hint.remotion: Cursor y via interpolate(frame, [0, 5], [y0, y1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); hovered card = card whose bounds contain the cursor that frame (hard toggle of tint and icon).

notes: The filmstrip is a cropped view of the right column. Per-frame hover toggles; no SFX candidates.
